entities.summary: Dmitri Nikolaevich Sheremetev was a Russian aristocratic, member of the Sheremetev family. He was the only son of Nikolai Sheremetev and Praskovia Kovalyova-Zhemchugova and the father of Aleksandr Sheremetev and Sergey Sheremetev.
